crossRefs.note: The king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them…
So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of…
But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him…
Of Damascus: “Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on…
and Hamath, also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered…
Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’ ”

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Ivvah
people.line: City conquered by Assyria, people resettled in Samaria.

people.name: Sepharvaim
people.line: City of origin for people resettled in Samaria
